en.decryption: Use the sequence of vows (Non-violence, Truth, Non-stealing, Non-possession, Chastity).

fact.en: Confusing the Chaturyama (Parshvanatha) with the Pancha Mahavrata (Mahavira). Parshvanatha gave only four.
fact.hi: Confusing the Chaturyama (Parshvanatha) with the Pancha Mahavrata (Mahavira). Parshvanatha gave only four.

fact.en: Assuming these vows apply equally to laypeople and monks. Laypeople follow Anuvratas (smaller vows), not the full Mahavratas.
fact.hi: Assuming these vows apply equally to laypeople and monks. Laypeople follow Anuvratas (smaller vows), not the full Mahavratas.

fact.en: Thinking Jainism invented these; the first four were pre-existing ascetic norms adapted by the Tirthankaras.
